blocks.content: The minimum line impedance is 2 K Ω (EIA-232-D standard: 3 K Ω min.)
The maximum line impedance is 30 K Ω (EIA-232-D standard: 7 K Ω max.)
The maximum line capacitance is 13 nF (EIA-232-D standard: 2,500 pF)

The communications default is 1200 BAUD, no parity, 8 data bits and 1 stop bit. The BAUD rate is selectable (1200, 2400, 4800, and 9600). The data format on the serial port is a 10 bit frame with asynchronous start and stop. The CTS line is held high and the RTS line is disconnected. The DataPort is isolated from the main system by an optical data path on the peripheral PWA and an isolated power supply.

The CPU subsystem interfaces the power supply subsystem by providing the MMIO signals needed  for  power  control  and  battery  management.  Additionally,  the  CPU  subsystem measures the battery terminal voltage and charge/discharge current via the ADC.
See Table 4-3 for CPU-power supply interface signals.

blocks.markdown:
Legend: P = Power;  A = Analog;  D = Digital;  I = Input;  O = Output

| D, I                                    | Digital startup pulse, used as interrupt to the CPU                                      | STRUPD*                                 |
| P                                       | 3.3 V system power                                                                       | V3_3                                    |
| P                                       | 5 V analog and interface power                                                           | V5_0/VANA                               |

| P                                       | 12 V, low current supply for audio alarm                                                 | V12_0                                   |
| D, I                                    | Signal that indicates overvoltage, regulation problem on the power supply main regulator | OVRVLT*                                 |
| D, I                                    | Buffered AC on signal                                                                    | BACON                                   |
| A, I                                    | Voltage proportional to integration of battery charge/discharge current                  | IBATT                                   |
| A,                                      | Divided battery terminal voltage                                                         | VBATT I                                 |
| D, O                                    | Battery charger enable                                                                   | CHG*                                    |
